description: Under the Czech act on public water supply and sewerage, the Ministry of Agriculture (MZe) benchmarks the owners and operators of water supply and sewerage every year and publishes a report for each year from 2015 to 2024; the 2024 report comes with tables for water supply (VODOVOD) and sewerage (KANALIZACE) in XLS. MZe produced a web presentation of the sector data it collects, from 2019, built on the central register of selected asset and operating records and the yearly comparisons of calculated and actual water and sewerage charges. Its reports for customers, owners, operators and a regional summary can be filtered by municipality, cadastral area, operator, owner or region and show charge structures, water losses, the number of failures, sample results, the share of wastewater led to treatment plants and renewal funding. Coverage is public water supply and sewerage in Czechia. The reports and tables are a free download on the ministry portal; no licence is stated. Caveats: the documents are in Czech, the report is published open for comments, and the indicators follow the ministry's benchmarking methodology. Simulation uses: utility losses, failures and renewal funding for capacity planning and resilience comparisons of Czech water utilities. Related records: the Danish water utility statistics (data-danva-vand-i-tal-danish-water-utility-statistics) and the Czech dam safety supervision register (data-czech-mze-dam-safety-supervision-register).
